info.name: Declut API
info.description:
Declut — escrow marketplace API for pre-owned household items. NestJS + MongoDB.

Folders mirror the URL path: each path segment is a folder, each :param is a {paramName} folder, and the request sits inside the deepest folder.

Run auth → register or auth → login first (auto-saves accessToken/refreshToken). Admin routes need a separate token from admin → auth → login (a regular-admin token never works on /admin/*, and vice versa). baseUrl defaults to http://localhost:3000/api.

request.description: Sends a 6-digit email verification OTP. Response includes emailVerified and kycStatus.

Returns a resetToken on success.

entityType is now a fixed enum: transaction, listing, review, report, article, campaign — omit for everything.
Bootstrap the first admin with: npm run seed:admin -- <email> <password> [name]

Every module defaults to {view:false,write:false,delete:false} unless overridden. title is a free-text job label, not a role — the only account roles are User and Admin; permissions are what actually distinguish one admin from another.
Partial patch — a module/action left out keeps its current value, it isn't reset to false. Separate from Create sub-admin, which does default omitted flags to false.
Emails a reset link (ADMIN_APP_URL/reset-password/{token}) — no OTP step. Silently no-ops if the email doesn't match an admin.
Paste the token from the emailed reset link (or the dev-environment server log, since Brevo isn't configured) into adminResetToken first.
token now travels as a URL param, matching the emailed reset link's own shape.

Not a real HTTP request (running it 404s — expected). Connect a Socket.IO client to {{wsBaseUrl}}/admin-notifications (no /api prefix) with auth: { token: adminAccessToken }. Events: transaction.disputed, transaction.stalled.
